segments.an6.51:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.an6.51:1.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an6.51:2.1: “Kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu assutañceva dhammaṃ suṇāti, sutā cassa dhammā na sammosaṃ gacchanti, ye cassa dhammā pubbe cetasā samphuṭṭhapubbā te ca samudācaranti, aviññātañca vijānātī”ti?
segments.an6.51:2.4: “Tenahāvuso sāriputta, suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.an6.51:2.5: “Evamāvuso”ti kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmato ānandassa paccassosi.
segments.an6.51:3.2: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
segments.an6.51:3.3: So yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti, yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ vāceti, yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti, yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasānupekkhati.
segments.an6.51:3.4: Yasmiṃ āvāse therā bhikkhū viharanti bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā tasmiṃ āvāse vassaṃ upeti.
segments.an6.51:3.5: Te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paripucchati paripañhati –
segments.an6.51:3.7: Te tassa āyasmato avivaṭañceva vivaranti, anuttānīkatañca uttānīkaronti, anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti.
segments.an6.51:3.8: Ettāvatā kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu assutañceva dhammaṃ suṇāti, sutā cassa dhammā na sammosaṃ gacchanti, ye cassa dhammā pubbe cetasā samphuṭṭhapubbā te ca samudācaranti, aviññātañca vijānātī”ti.
segments.an6.51:4.1: “Acchariyaṃ, āvuso, abbhutaṃ, āvuso, yāva subhāsitaṃ cidaṃ āyasmatā ānandena.
segments.an6.51:4.2: Imehi ca mayaṃ chahi dhammehi samannāgataṃ āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ dhārema.
segments.an6.51:4.4: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
segments.an6.51:4.5: Āyasmā ānando yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti, āyasmā ānando yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ vāceti, āyasmā ānando yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti, āyasmā ānando yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasānupekkhati.
segments.an6.51:4.6: Āyasmā ānando yasmiṃ āvāse therā bhikkhū viharanti bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā tasmiṃ āvāse vassaṃ upeti.
segments.an6.51:4.7: Te āyasmā ānando kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paripucchati paripañhati –
segments.an6.51:4.9: Te āyasmato ānandassa avivaṭañceva vivaranti, anuttānīkatañca uttānīkaronti, anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodentī”ti.

lines: Āgatāgamāti dīghādīsu yo koci āgamo āgato etesanti āgatāgamā.
Idaṃ, bhante, kathanti, bhante, idaṃ anusandhipubbāparaṃ kathaṃ hotīti pucchati.
Imassa kvatthoti imassa bhāsitassa ko atthoti pucchati.
Tattha yasmiṃ dhamme kaṅkhā uppajjati, sveva kaṅkhāṭhāniyo nāmāti veditabbo. 10.
Navame therā bhikkhū viharanti bahussutā āgatāgamātiādipāḷipadesu imināva nayena attho daṭṭhabbo – sīlādiguṇānaṃ thirabhāvappattiyā therā.
Vācuggatadhāraṇena sammadeva garūnaṃ santike āgamitabhāvena āgato pariyattidhammasaṅkhāto āgamo etesanti āgatāgamā.
Kaṅkhāṭṭhāniyesu dhammesu saṃsayuppattiyā hetuyā gaṇṭhiṭṭhānabhūtesu pāḷipadesu yāthāvato vinicchayadānena kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti.
